column3: Average of the Groundedness judge score (0–1) on these tests. Each test's score = the share of factual claims in Mira's answer that are supported by the data Mira retrieved (supported claims ÷ total claims).

column3: Average of the Correctness judge score (0–1) on these tests. Each test is graded against its numbered criteria: 1.0 = all items met; 0.5 = one or two items not met; 0 = three or more items not met, or the wrong action (e.g. asking for details instead of answering).

column2: Do counts, statuses and dates match the task board and timeline?
column3: Average of the Correctness judge score (0–1) on these tests, graded the same way as Risk relevance. T10 (the task counts) must score exactly 1.0.
